description: Header file defining classes and templates for managing dynamic argument lists in a C++ formatting library, including argument storage, unwrapping, and argument pushing mechanisms.

classes.name: node
classes.description: A template struct representing a node in a linked list, with a virtual destructor and a unique pointer to the next node.

classes.name: dynamic_arg_list
classes.description: Class managing a linked list of argument nodes, supporting push operations with type-specific node creation.

classes.name: dynamic_format_arg_store
classes.description: Template class for storing a dynamic list of formatting arguments, supporting addition, clearing, and reservation of arguments.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Template method to add a new argument node to the dynamic argument list.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Template method to add an argument to the store, handling copying, referencing, and string management.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Method to erase all stored arguments and reset internal state.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Method to pre-allocate space for a specified number of arguments and named arguments.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of stored arguments.
